items.label: Modern Farmhouse Touch
items.value: The appearance of white and natural wood grain adds a vintage aesthetic to your living room or entryway, and this console table takes a cue from farmhouse style to create a cozy feel in your living space

items.label: Double-Layer Storage
items.value: This charming entryway table features two decorative shelves, offering convenient extra storage to help declutter your entryway or showcase favorite decor pieces—keeping your space organized and stylish

items.label: Long-Lasting Resilience
items.value: Crafted from high-grade MDF, our console table for entryway is built to withstand everyday use. The thick tabletop supports up to 300 lb, making it easy to hold heavier items like books or decorative objects without sagging

items.label: Versatile and Widely Used
items.value: Place it anywhere—this accent table adapts to your needs. Use it as a TV stand, bar table, sofa table, entryway organizer, or sideboard, offering worry-free storage and display for your belongings

items.label: Easy Assembly and Service
items.value: For quick setup, all required tools and illustrated instructions are included. Should you find any damage or defects with your Tribesigns console table, simply consult us—we offer a solution within 24 hours
